criterion.criterion_summary: A known reversed endpoint must not be storage-order oriented. Unknown/equivalence-class edges must not be chosen by storage order and then relabeled as a DAG or allowed to introduce cycles; consumers need a valid acyclic extension with known directions preserved. A sound general partial-graph extension/identification method is a separate unresolved choice.

coverage_owner.criterion_specific_acceptance_not_execut: PAG/CPDAG projection cannot reverse a known direction or introduce a cycle. Distinguish unknown/equivalence classes from known arrows, produce an acyclic extension, and prove downstream DAG consumers use it. Source-card check UNRUN; J1062 is B215 only.

It includes route-same-snapshot cases, mutation/noncanonical-container adversarial cases, and passing gate-removal marker controls. The independent report judges the structural snapshot property GO-limited only.
property_and_result.p37: The schema field set and consumed nested values are recomputed from declared runtime model fields/annotations. PAG/CPDAG extension-set semantics, external causal truth and probability remain not_established.
property_and_result.p38: The guarded property is equality of the admitted graph input and the graph actually consumed. The implementation rebuilds one detached snapshot and passes it to the gate and consumer; the divergent case is a caller mutating/overriding nested graph containers after admission, which otherwise could make the consumer use different bytes than the checked graph. The actual selected tests exercise same-snapshot use and typed refusal.
